presetProfessionalText.message: You are a professional AI assistant. Always respond in a formal, respectful, and business-appropriate manner. Use proper grammar and avoid casual language or emojis.

presetFriendlyText.message: You are a friendly and warm AI assistant. Use a conversational tone, be approachable, and feel free to use appropriate emojis. Make responses feel personal and caring.

presetBriefText.message: You are a concise AI assistant. Always keep responses short, direct, and to the point. Avoid lengthy explanations unless specifically asked. Maximum 1-2 sentences per response.

presetCreativeText.message: You are a creative and imaginative AI assistant. Feel free to be innovative, suggest unique ideas, and use creative language. Think outside the box and offer original perspectives.

presetSupportText.message: You are a helpful customer support agent. Be patient, understanding, and solution-focused. Always try to resolve issues and provide clear, actionable guidance. Ask clarifying questions when needed.

presetTranslatorText.message: You are a helpful translation assistant. When someone writes in a language other than English, provide the translation and respond appropriately in their language. If they write in English, respond in English.

defaultSystemInstructions.message: You are a helpful AI assistant that generates appropriate responses for WhatsApp conversations. Keep responses natural, conversational, and contextually relevant.

helpStep1.message: Install the Extension: Load the extension in Chrome by going to chrome://extensions/, enabling Developer mode, and clicking "Load unpacked" to select the extension folder.

helpStep2.message: Get Gemini API Key: Visit Google AI Studio and create a free API key for Gemini.

helpStep3.message: Open WhatsApp Web: Navigate to web.whatsapp.com and scan the QR code to log in.

helpStep4.message: Configure Settings: Click the floating AI button and go to Settings, choose your AI provider (Gemini or DeepSeek), and enter its API key.

helpFeatureExportDesc.message: Extract and download complete WhatsApp conversations as text files for backup or analysis.

helpFeatureAiDesc.message: Generate contextually appropriate responses using your choice of Google Gemini or DeepSeek, based on conversation history.

helpFeatureIntegrationDesc.message: Seamlessly insert AI-generated responses directly into WhatsApp's message input field.

helpFeatureCopyDesc.message: Easily copy generated responses to use in other applications or modify before sending.

helpExportStep2.message: Click the green floating AI button (bottom-right corner)

helpExportStep4.message: The conversation will be downloaded as a text file

helpGenerateStep1.message: Make sure you've selected an AI provider and configured its API key

helpGenerateStep5.message: Wait for the AI to analyze the conversation and generate a response

helpGenerateStep6.message: Choose to either copy the response or insert it directly into the chat

helpInsertWarning.message: The extension only fills the response into the chat input box — you must click WhatsApp's own send button yourself. The extension never sends messages automatically.

helpMessageDetectionDesc.message: The extension automatically detects both incoming and outgoing messages using these CSS selectors:

helpProviderSetupDesc.message: In Settings, use the "AI Provider" dropdown to pick Gemini or DeepSeek. When DeepSeek is selected, a second dropdown lets you pick the model (DeepSeek V4 Flash or V4 Pro). Gemini currently only offers a single model, so no model dropdown is shown for it.

helpApiKeySetupStep2.message: Sign in with your Google account

helpApiKeySetupStep4.message: Copy the generated API key (starts with "AIza")

helpApiKeySetupStep5.message: In WhatsApp Web, click the AI button → Settings

helpApiKeySetupStep6.message: Paste your API key and save

helpApiKeySetupStep7.message: Use the "Test Connection" button to verify it works

helpDeepSeekApiKeySetupStep2.message: Sign in and add a payment method / top up your balance

helpDeepSeekApiKeySetupStep4.message: Copy the generated API key (starts with "sk-")

helpDeepSeekApiKeySetupStep5.message: In WhatsApp Web, click the AI button → Settings, select "DeepSeek" as the provider

helpDeepSeekApiKeySetupStep6.message: Paste your API key, pick a model, and save

helpWarningApiKeyText.message: Keep your API key secure and never share it publicly. The extension stores it locally in your browser.

helpAiIntegrationDesc.message: The extension can call either Google's Gemini 2.0 Flash model or DeepSeek's chat completions API (V4 Flash / V4 Pro), depending on which provider you select:

helpSupportedItem6.message: ⚠️ Recent images (Gemini only — up to 3 of the most recent images are sent as visual context; not supported with DeepSeek yet)

helpExtNotWorkingItem2.message: Check if the extension is enabled in chrome://extensions/

helpExtNotWorkingItem3.message: Make sure you're on web.whatsapp.com (not other WhatsApp versions)

helpAiNotGeneratingItem1.message: Verify the API key for your selected provider (Gemini or DeepSeek) is correctly entered

helpAiNotGeneratingItem3.message: Ensure you haven't exceeded API rate limits

helpAiNotGeneratingItem4.message: Try again in a few moments

helpMessagesNotExtractingItem1.message: Make sure the conversation is fully loaded

helpMessagesNotExtractingItem2.message: Scroll up to load older messages if needed

helpMessagesNotExtractingItem3.message: Refresh the page and try again

helpPrivacyItem1.message: Message capture, caching, and formatting all happen locally in your browser

helpPrivacyItem2.message: Your API keys are stored in Chrome's sync storage and each is only ever sent to its own provider (Gemini key to Google, DeepSeek key to DeepSeek)

helpPrivacyItem3.message: When you request an AI response, the full conversation text — plus up to 3 recent images if you're using Gemini — is sent to whichever provider you have selected; this is not purely local processing, so evaluate whether this fits your data compliance needs before using it with real customer conversations

helpPrivacyItem4.message: No data is stored on any server other than your selected provider's, and only for the duration of the API call

helpPrivacyItem5.message: The extension only runs on web.whatsapp.com
